types.description: Schneider Electric 29321 - set of 2 short terminal shields, 3 poles, for Compact NS100/160/250 (legacy Merlin Gerin MGE.29321)

document.title: 29321 - 2 short terminal shields - 3 poles - for NS100..250 (Schneider Electric product record)
document.revision: Online product page; identity corroborated by Substitution guide Compact NSX100 to 630, p.16

modelingNotes: Insulation accessory: a pair of short terminal shields that clip over the line/load power terminals of a 3-pole Compact NS100/160/250 moulded-case circuit breaker to prevent direct contact and preserve IEC 60947-2 clearance/creepage. Supplied as a set of 2 (upstream + downstream).

Purely mechanical, non-conductive insulating shroud: it has zero electrical terminals and forms no conductive path. It does not terminate, jumper, short or bond the host breaker's poles; the breaker's three poles remain electrically separate.
Ratings and pole count belong to the host breaker; the shield adds no electrical rating of its own, so no rating/nominal_voltage is assigned to this part.

Legacy Merlin Gerin order code MGE.29321. Schneider Substitution guide Compact NSX100 to 630 (p.16) lists 29321 as '2 short terminal shields 3P (NS100/250)'; the Compact NSX equivalent short 3P shield is LV429515 (different packaging). No successor is substituted here - 29321 is modeled exactly.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical insulating terminal shield; no electrical terminals or circuit functions by design. The empty electrical inventory is exhaustive. Fit and installed clearance depend on the specified 3-pole Compact NS100..250 breaker and connection type.

COVER.connector: Short terminal shields (set of 2) for 3-pole Compact NS100/160/250 power terminals
COVER.description: Mechanical insulating cover only; no electrical pins, no continuity, no bonding.
